items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer mentions Armstrong's troubles and Canetti taking Armstrong out; Interviewee only confirms 'Yes' and 'To lead the orchestra' without claiming personal interaction.

ctx.x: Yeh, we didn't have any symptoms of any racial dissensions.
Well, while we're on that subject, I know that Armstrong had trouble getting accommodations when he came to Europe.
